# MatchMySkillset

> Upload your CV and see live UK jobs scored against your skills, with the careers your skills point to and what they pay. The site focuses on engineering, manufacturing and Industry 4.0 (maintenance, CNC, robotics and automation, 3D printing, and AI and connected technology in production), and the CV match works for any job. Free for job seekers, with no account. Employers post jobs on paid plans and meet candidates matched on skills. MatchMySkillset is a joint venture with Flintstone Associates, a specialist recruitment firm whose recruiters prepare the shortlists employers can ask for.

Live jobs come from Reed, Adzuna, GOV.UK Teaching Vacancies, Himalayas and Remotive, and from employers who post on MatchMySkillset. Pay figures come from the Office for National Statistics Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE) 2025, Table 14.7a (provisional, published 23 October 2025): median and percentile gross annual pay for full-time employee jobs in the UK, by four-digit SOC 2020 occupation group. Each career is placed in the SOC 2020 unit group the ONS coding index (version 14) gives for its title. ASHE covers employees only, not the self-employed; ONS publishes ASHE 2026 on 22 October 2026 and the pages will be updated then. Occupation titles and entry-route descriptions come from ONS SOC 2020 Volume 1; routes into each job from National Careers Service job profiles; apprenticeship levels and typical durations from Skills England's apprenticeship standards (England); licences from the body that issues each one. Pages show the source and publication date beside each figure. Content is written for UK readers.

## Engineering, manufacturing and Industry 4.0

- [Engineering and manufacturing jobs](https://matchmyskillset.com/engineering-and-manufacturing-jobs): careers from maintenance and machining to robotics, automation and design, with ONS pay and the ways in
- [Robotics and automation jobs](https://matchmyskillset.com/robotics-and-automation-jobs): automation technician, automation, robotics and mechatronics engineer, and how maintenance, CNC and electrical technicians move into automation
- [3D printing and additive manufacturing jobs](https://matchmyskillset.com/3d-printing-jobs): 3D printing technician and additive manufacturing engineer roles, pay ranges and routes in
- [Graduate engineering jobs](https://matchmyskillset.com/graduate-engineering-jobs): where an engineering degree or degree apprenticeship leads in advanced manufacturing, with ONS pay ranges
- [Jobs for ex-military](https://matchmyskillset.com/jobs-for-ex-military): civilian routes for service leavers, led by engineering, maintenance and advanced manufacturing, plus resettlement support

## Tools

- [Match my CV](https://matchmyskillset.com/discover): upload a CV to see live UK jobs scored against your skills, the careers that fit with ONS pay, and the gaps to close (free, no account, works for any job)
- [Find jobs](https://matchmyskillset.com/jobs): live UK vacancies
- [Transferable skills finder](https://matchmyskillset.com/transferable-skills): pick your current job to see the skills that carry over
- [Career quiz](https://matchmyskillset.com/quiz): a 10-question quiz that suggests careers to explore

## For employers

- [For employers](https://matchmyskillset.com/employers): post jobs, see applicants with a skills match score, search people who chose to be found, and ask for a recruiter shortlist on Growth and Enterprise
- [Employer pricing](https://matchmyskillset.com/employers/pricing)

## Other careers

- [Careers by profession](https://matchmyskillset.com/careers-for): start from the job you do now, with routes and ONS pay for many professions
- [Leaving teaching](https://matchmyskillset.com/career-change-from-teaching): jobs teachers move into, with UK pay and routes
- [Non-clinical jobs for nurses](https://matchmyskillset.com/non-clinical-jobs-for-nurses): roles for nurses and NHS staff away from the bedside
- [Jobs for ex-police officers](https://matchmyskillset.com/jobs-for-ex-police-officers): where police officers go next
- [Leaving retail](https://matchmyskillset.com/career-change-from-retail): jobs for retail staff and managers

- [Well-paid jobs without a degree](https://matchmyskillset.com/jobs-without-a-degree): best-paid jobs with an apprenticeship or licence route below degree level
- [UK jobs by salary band](https://matchmyskillset.com/what-jobs): how occupations spread across pay bands
- [Jobs that pay £30k](https://matchmyskillset.com/what-jobs/jobs-that-pay-30k)

- [Low-stress jobs in the UK](https://matchmyskillset.com/low-stress-jobs-uk): HSE work-related stress rates by occupation group, alongside ONS pay
